# Do not import from this directory directly

All files in this directory are **auto-generated by Orval** from the OpenAPI spec.
They are regenerated whenever `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen` is run.

## Correct usage

Always import from the package root:

```ts
import { PromoCodeInput, useGetRoom, setBaseUrl } from "@workspace/api-client-react";
```

Never import from deep paths:

```ts
// BAD — breaks when generated filenames change
import { PromoCodeInput } from "@workspace/api-client-react/src/generated/api.schemas";
```

The barrel at `lib/api-client-react/src/index.ts` uses `export *` to automatically
re-export every type and hook that codegen produces, so no manual listing is needed
and no new schema type will ever be missed.

## Validation

Run `pnpm run validate:imports` at the workspace root to confirm no consumer
is importing from these internal paths.
